language: Use the language of the assignment.
access: Use local synthetic data. Confirm required external services, credentials and access with the project.
verify: Verify when user-visible behaviour changes or the task has key scenarios. Otherwise the delivery says in one line why not.
verifier: A fresh agent that did not write the change.
evidence: Attach evidence files to the PR (`gh --attach` on GitHub), test data only. Without a PR keep them where the project's verify skill names.
ci: No external CI is required for the local baseline.
delivery_checks: Run all required local checks and record results at the delivery revision.
